preamble: Debuccalization of the velar nasal [ŋ] to a glottal stop [ʔ], mostly in word-final position. It is a hallmark of Nenets and Enets, where the Proto-Samoyedic final *ŋ became a glottal stop, while Nganasan and Selkup kept the nasal.

examples.to: Tundra Nenets няʼ; Forest Enets наʼ; Tundra Enets эʼ
examples.note: cf. Nganasan ӈаӈ, Selkup ө̄ӈ, Kamassian аӈ

examples.to: Tundra Nenets тэ̇ʼ; Forest Enets тыʼ
examples.note: cf. Forest Nenets тэӈ, Kamassian тхен

sources: Janhunen, J. (1977). Samojedischer Wortschatz: Gemeinsamojedische Etymologien. Helsinki: Castrenianum.
